title: cyclophorus porosus
intro: Cyclophorus porosus, commonly known as the Asian swamp fern, is a type of plant species belonging to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been utilized in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cyclophorus porosus include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and demonstrate anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its potential therapeutic applications.
